name: First Builder
criteria: Successfully build a functional robot base with wheels and motors that can drive

name: Code Starter
description: Wrote and ran your first program
criteria: Create and successfully run a program with at least 3 commands

name: Driver's Seat
description: Successfully drove the robot in practice
criteria: Drive the robot through a simple course without major collisions

name: Team Player
description: Participated in all four team roles
criteria: Take a turn as Builder, Programmer, Driver, and Documenter

name: Notebook Keeper
criteria: Create 5 documented notebook entries with dates, sketches, and notes

name: Problem Spotter
description: Identified a design problem and proposed a solution
criteria: Document a problem with the robot design and suggest an improvement

name: Safety Champion
description: Perfect safety record for one month
criteria: Follow all safety rules for 4 consecutive practice sessions with no incidents

name: Parts Expert
criteria: Correctly identify 20 different VEX IQ parts by name in a timed challenge

name: Sensor Explorer
description: Successfully used a sensor in a program
criteria: Write a program that uses sensor input to make a decision (IF-THEN)

name: Square Driver
description: Programmed robot to drive in a square path
criteria: Create a program that drives the robot in a square, returning to start within 6 inches
